name: Waltrop (Germany)
description: Seven equal horizontal stripes of black and white, charged at the centre with the city arms of Waltrop (a black eagle on yellow).
history: Municipal flag of Waltrop; German municipalities use their flags alongside the arms, the hoisted form (Hissflagge) and the hanging banner (Banner) sharing the same design.

features.role: Waltrop arms — black eagle on yellow
